items.exampleEn: Video games occupy most of my brother's free time.
items.exampleZh: 電動遊戲占去了我弟弟大部分的空閒時間。

items.exampleEn: Every encounter with that dog scares me.
items.exampleZh: 每次遇到那隻狗都讓我很害怕。
這件外套很能保持熱度。

items.exampleEn: A strip of land runs along the river.
items.exampleZh: 一條狹長的土地沿著河延伸。

items.exampleEn: She paused for a moment before answering.
Every time I give an idea, my brother counters it.
items.exampleZh: 每次我提出想法，我哥都會反駁。

items.exampleEn: The car crashed into a tree.
She possesses great skill as a painter.
items.exampleZh: 她擁有高超的繪畫技巧。

items.sentenceEn: Let's pause the movie and get some snacks.
items.sentenceZh: 我們把電影暫停，去拿點零食吧。

items.audioEn: Don't run with those glasses, or they will crash to the floor.
items.audioZh: 拿著那些杯子別跑，不然會摔到地上。
items.questionZh: 為什麼不要拿著杯子跑？
options: The glasses may fall and break.

items.sentenceEn: Visitors are not allowed to occupy these seats.
items.sentenceZh: 訪客不可以占用這些座位。

items.sentenceEn: My computer crashed, and I lost my work.
items.sentenceZh: 我的電腦當機了，做好的東西都不見了。

items.stemEn: Cut the carrots into thin ____ before you cook them.
items.stemZh: 煮之前先把紅蘿蔔切成細條。

items.stemEn: She ____ my argument with a strong example.
items.stemZh: 她用一個有力的例子反駁了我的論點。

items.passageEn: On my way to school yesterday, I had a strange encounter. An old man occupied the whole bench at the bus stop with his bags. He has a reputation as a storyteller in our town. He told me that he possessed a very old map of our city, drawn on a long strip of paper. I said it looked new, but he countered that it was two hundred years old. He had retained it since his father gave it to him. Suddenly, we heard a loud crash: a bike had hit a parked car. Everyone paused to look. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
items.passageZh: 昨天上學途中，我有一次奇怪的相遇。一位老先生用他的袋子占滿了公車站的整張長椅。他在我們鎮上是出了名的說故事高手。他告訴我，他擁有一張我們城市的古老地圖，畫在一長條紙上。我說那看起來很新，但他反駁說那已經有兩百年了。自從他父親把地圖交給他，他就一直保留著。突然，我們聽到一聲巨響：一輛腳踏車撞上了一輛停著的車。大家都停下來看。幸好沒有人受傷。

questions.questionZh: 老先生怎麼說那張地圖？

options: 一位老人在公車站大聲唱歌
一輛腳踏車撞到停著的車

referenceEn: He possesses three cars of different kinds.
rubricZh: possess 表示「擁有」，例如 possess cars 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 encounter 造一個句子，說說你曾有過的一次特別的相遇。
referenceEn: I had a funny encounter with a famous singer at the airport.
My first encounter with snow was on a mountain.
rubricZh: encounter 表示「相遇、遭遇」，例如 have an encounter with… 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
